name: Hayakawa Ken'ichi
source:
A member of the "Creative Society", Seigi's friend and classmate. Although he's handsome and popular with the girls, he is not interested in three-dimensional women. He prefers to "chase" after two-dimensional girls. Also, he likes hentai games with rape.
